item.title: THROUGH THE UPRIGHTS: From Klein to the NFL -- The Randy Bullock Story
item.description: What a journey Randy Bullock has had. The former Klein Bearkat was a national recruit coming out of high school before taking his talents to Texas A&M. As an Aggie, Bullock delivered some huge kicks, earning the prestigious Lou Groza Award, and eventually heard his name called in the NFL Draft by the Houston Texans. In this episode, Bullock reflects on the ups and downs of life as an NFL kicker and shares what moments stand out to him the most. Check out the full podcast.
